kevin: quick thread on deterministic merge ordering + preview API. we keep hitting nondeterministic route scores in canaries. idea: define canonical merge + scoring pipeline so all replicas produce bitwise identical policy blobs after apply. specifics: 1) canonical key ordering, 2) stable sort for model-variant candidates, 3) canonical JSON serialization (no whitespace, consistent number formatting), 4) attach canonical_hash to policy_version. thoughts?
jessie: love the canonical_hash approach. helps diffs and rollout checks. need to document canonical JSON rules: RFC3339 timestamps normalized, floats rounded to N decimals, enums lowercase.
anya: also add a 'preview' flag to ApplyDelta that returns the canonical_hash and the top-N diffed routes for selected tenants without committing. ops can run preview against replicas to confirm identical canonical_hash before pointer-swap.
miguel: runtime implementation note: merging must be off-thread with deterministic map iteration. in go, iterate over sorted keys. also ensure that when multiple deltas are applied concurrently we serialize application order by delta_seq. concurrency hazards are main source of divergence.
elena: ops-facing: preview should allow sampling a small set of traffic and include a safety check: if canonical_hash differs across >X% of replicas, abort rollout. also include a deterministic tie-breaker rule for equal scores: prefer lower policy_id then lower model_variant_id.
sam: add telemetry: policy_apply_duration_ms, canonical_hash_mismatch_count, preview_failed_quorum_total. alerts for mismatch spikes. also make sure tracing includes delta_id and canonical_hash so SRE can find traces linked to mismatches.
kevin: edge-case: numeric nondeterminism from quantization thresholds and machine-dependent float behaviors. mitigation: define integerized score representation for policy-level decisions (scale floats by 1e6 then round) and use that for sorting and hashing. document in RFC.
jessie: one more: preview API should support a 'dryrun-merge' endpoint that takes a small tenant sample list and returns (merged_blob, canonical_hash, diffs). make it restricted to internal role.
miguel: implement preview as streaming RPC to avoid memory spikes for large merged blobs. preview can also return deterministic small fingerprint per tenant to speed checks.
ops-bot: info: preview job completed for delta=1710009999-preview job_id=pj-42, mismatches=0
anya: followups: (1) update policy schema with canonicalization rules (jessie), (2) implement preview/dryrun RPC + role gating (miguel + elena), (3) add telemetry + alerting (sam), (4) add documentation + e2e before we allow auto-promote canaries (kevin).
kevin: planning note: schedule a 45min deep-dive next Thu. thanks all.
